html:
Tint a Car offers an affordable window tint that not only looks great but also reduces glare & heat and rejects 99% of harmful UV rays. Below is information on Midnight Express, our value for money car window tint – starting from just $295 – this affordable tint is a great option to go with.

Tint a Car specialises in window tinting and has been providing tinting services in Australia for 40+ years. We are Australia’s most trusted window tinting network and pride ourselves on providing high-quality affordable window tinting throughout Australia. Learn more about Midnight Express, our affordable window tinting option:

Affordable Window Tinting & Great Value For Money

Whilst Midnight Express is our value for money affordable tint, it still packs a punch when it comes to its features & benefits, which include:

  • Rejects 99% of UV rays protection you & your passengers and also your car’s interior
  • Reduces heat and glare
  • Looks awesome!
  • Government certified by ARPANSA
  • Exclusive to Tint a Car
  • Has a Nationwide lifetime warranty
  • Has a 30-day money-back guarantee if you’re not completely satisfied

Other tints in our range include:

  • Octane – Our darkest legal tint
  • High Octane – Our darkest legal safety tint
  • Spectre – Uses innovative ceramic technology to provide the highest infrared heat rejection
  • Formula One – Offers UPF50+ solar protection and optical clarity

These tints are also ARPANSA certified and are covered by our warranty.

Affordable Tinting With ZERO INTEREST Payment Options

Affordable window tinting just got even more affordable! We now accept both ZipPay and Open Pay where you can split your purchases over 3, 6, 9, or 12 months with ZERO interest…. So you can get affordable tint now, and pay later!

Ask Us About Affordable Window Tinting Options Today

Ask our team of window tinting experts about affordable tint options. They can also provide information on our interest-free payment plans too.

Use our Store Finder to find your local tinting team or call 13 TINT now. We will be able to provide you with a quote so you know how much your tinting will cost.
